summary.phase1_data_structure: Implemented ConversationMetadata schema with job_id, user_id, project_id, workflow_id. Updated Valkey store to support extended metadata.
summary.phase2_diagnostic_api: Implemented GET /v1/chat/diagnostics/{conversation_id} (single) and GET /v1/chat/diagnostics (list with filters). Both endpoints support filtering by job_id, user_id, project_id, workflow_id, and date range.
summary.phase3_langfuse_integration: Integrated Langfuse trace link generation in DiagnosticInfo schema.
summary.phase4_tests: 95 unit tests and 19 integration tests - all passing. Ruff and MyPy errors: 0.
summary.backward_compatibility: Existing conversation_id based operations remain unchanged. New endpoints are additive.
